question: Where is the breath-filled vital air established within living beings?
premises: There is air filled with breath
This air is present in beings
Its presence extends to all living beings
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam may reflect transmitted phrasing.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
